fit: Keep each saved daily exit, entry/cohort gates, allocation and budget. Fit one additional uniform scale to minimize the absolute difference in total entry capital on completed training trades at 5% sale cost. Ties choose the smaller scale. No return or evaluation-period quantity is used to select the scale.
scope: Retrospective exposure control for model modifiers. The uniform scale can change daily using earlier completed trades. It is not a fixed strategy or independent performance validation. Matching previous entry capital does not guarantee equal future exposure or drawdown.
